_doc: Role specialisation perks (spec: Roles & Character Identity, 'short skill tree per Role, XCOM-style branching choices'). HOUSE-RULE game content, not from the core book: two tiers per Role, pick one perk of the two in each tier. Tier 1 costs tier_cost[0] IP; tier 2 costs tier_cost[1] IP, needs a tier-1 perk and Role Rank >= tier2_rank. Effects: skills (flat skill bonuses), net_actions (+NET Actions per turn), jack_range_m (meatspace jack-in range), stabilize_reach (squares), revive (stabilized allies stay conscious at BODY HP), treat_discount (clinic price multiplier), upgrade_bonus (Tech workshop checks), salvage_mult (salvage multiplier; unused since salvage was removed).

netrunner.name: Long Leash
netrunner.desc: Jack in and stay connected from 10 m instead of 6.

medtech.name: Triage
medtech.desc: Stabilize an ally up to 2 squares away.

medtech.name: Revive
medtech.desc: Stabilized allies stay conscious with BODY HP.

medtech.name: Trauma Surgeon
medtech.desc: Clinic treatment for the crew costs half.

tech.name: Field Tech
tech.desc: +2 Basic Tech: jury-rigs land more often.

tech.name: Demolitions
tech.desc: +2 Athletics: grenades land where you throw them.

tech.name: Armorsmith
tech.desc: +2 to Upgrade checks in the workshop.

tech.name: Scavenger
tech.desc: No effect for now: salvage was removed (core-book ruling); awaiting a replacement.
